description: This file defines a plugin for the Trumbowyg WYSIWYG editor, adding font size customization features including multiple language support and a dropdown menu for selecting font sizes.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Sets the font size of the selected text in the editor by replacing font tags with span elements styled with the specified size.

methods.name: buildDropdown
methods.description: Builds the dropdown menu for font size options, including custom size option if enabled.
